semiconductor_relevance: High — Dynax develops advanced substrates for printed circuit boards that significantly enhance thermal conductivity, which is critical in semiconductor applications.
summary: Dynax specializes in the development of high-performance substrates for printed circuit boards, leveraging automotive manufacturing technology to improve heat dissipation. Their innovative approach replaces conventional glass cloth with advanced materials that can be tailored for superior thermal conductivity.
capabilities: High-performance substrates for printed circuit boards
Thermal interface materials with enhanced heat dissipation
Customizable substrate properties through fiber and filler blending
